description: Unofficial Windows desktop media center for movies, series, live TV, and music.
pre_install: if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir 'Nuvio One.exe') -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'The official portable ZIP did not extract Nuvio One.exe into the expected application directory.' }
notes: Uses the official Windows portable ZIP. Application settings and cache are redirected to the Scoop persist directory through APPDATA and LOCALAPPDATA.

Use 'scoop update nuvio-one-desktop' for updates. Do not use the application's in-app updater when you want to keep the Scoop-managed portable installation; upstream's portable build updater installs the MSI.
Windows DPAPI protects some saved secrets for the current Windows user. Copying the persist folder to another Windows account or machine may make those encrypted values unreadable.
